subject: Media Literacy
title: How Social Media Amplifies Falsehoods
description: Learn How Social Media Amplifies Falsehoods in one minute.

hook.text: MIT found false stories spread six times faster than true ones on Twitter. Lies are more engaging than truth.

buildup.text: Social media algorithms prioritize engagement. False stories generate more reactions — likes, shares, comments.

discovery.text: False stories trigger surprise and disgust — emotions that drive sharing more than any others.

twist.text: By the time a fact-check is published, the false story has already reached millions. Corrections can't catch up.

climax.text: The architecture of social media gives falsehood a structural advantage over truth.

punchline.text: Truth is slow. Lies are viral. The platform rewards speed.

quiz.question: According to MIT research, how much faster does false news spread than true news?
